thread:
ranjit: quick check — thinking about provenance stamping for usage events. do we want the provenance envelope on the ingress event or as a sidecar audit event?

maria: my gut is envelope on ingress for locality — keeps replay idempotent and self-contained. but it bloats the hot path.

devon: +1 on localizing, but that means every downstream joins need to keep the envelope schema stable forever. migrations are painful.

claudia: can we do a hybrid? minimal envelope on ingress (fingerprint + source) and then emit richer audit events async? that keeps hot path small and audit searchable.

ranjit: thats what i sketched. minimal: {fingerprint, tenant_id, model_variant, parent_token_id?} — optional fields nullable.

maria: can you paste the minimal proto sketch?

ranjit: sure —

```json
{
  "event_id": "uuid",
  "fingerprint": "sha256(...)",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "model": "gptx-12b",
  "seq_len": 123,
  "parent_token_id": null,
  "ts": 1667778888000
}
```

devon: ok that fits. question: who owns canonicalization? ingest team or meter-recon team?

claudia: we need single owner to avoid divergent fingerprints. propose ownership by ingest with a small conformance test repo maintained in eng-platform.

maria: +1. add version header so recon can accept multiple fingerprint versions. fallback rules required.

ranjit: fallback rules: 1) if fingerprint missing, route to slow-path rehydrate. 2) if version mismatch, route to compatibility reader that rehashes using mapping.

devon: how about late arrivals? audit events may arrive after billing windows. do we retroactively amend ledgers?

claudia: we shouldn't mutate prior finalized invoices. instead produce a correction event that is additive and surfaced in reconciliation UI. Ledgers remain append-only.

maria: important for SLA. corrections must have provenance back to original ingestion fingerprint and operator ID.

ranjit: telemetry note: prefix-caching will hide some attribution flips. ensure cache invalidation on correction events.

sre-bot: deploy job queued: metering/ingest-fingerprint-validator v0.1.3 — CI green.

devon: action items: (1) ingest owns canonicalizer + conformance tests (2) implement minimal envelope + async audit emit (3) reconciliation UI to accept correction events (4) add fingerprint version header + compatibility reader.

claudia: I'll draft an RFC PR with the schema and compatibility matrix. expecting review from @maria and @devon.

maria: timeline?

claudia: RFC by EOW, prototype ingest validator next week, compatibility shim in 2 sprints.

ranjit: also flag: cost estimate for added bytes on hot path. if >1.2% token-unit cost we fallback to sampled envelope.

devon: can we add a sampling knob per-tenant? lower tier tenants sample to reduce cost.

maria: yep config in tenant profile + metric. add to RFC.

ranjit: cool. thanks all. closing thread, will watch RFC PR. :thumbsup:
